artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact bounded check of the modulo-eight theorem and odd RMS residues.

limitations: The residue obstruction is for odd \(n\). For \(r\equiv0\pmod4\) the mean is always one modulo eight, so no residue restriction on \(n\) follows. Originality is best-of-knowledge against incompletely indexed informal sequence discussion.
provenance: Scientific record; fresh independent scientific assessment completed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: A mod-8 obstruction for odd divisor power means
scientific_context: A modulo-eight formula in the 2-adic integers for the even-power divisor mean of odd integers, with an RMS-number residue consequence.
